extracted.name: Velveeta Cheesy Broccoli Soup
extracted.description: This Velveeta broccoli cheese soup recipe is the real deal and ready in less than 30 minutes. Easy and satisfying comfort food everyone will love.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped broccoli, thawed, drained
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large saucepan on medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Add flour; cook 1 minute or until bubbly, stirring constantly.
Stir in milk. Bring to boil. Reduce heat to medium-low; simmer for 1 minute.
Add remaining ingredients; Velveeta cheese, broccoli, and pepper. Cook until cheese is melted and soup is heated through, stirring occasionally.
